description.value: Alpine Lodge Fernie is an award-winning, purpose-built inn-style lodge at Fernie Alpine Resort — the largest lodge at the resort, accommodating groups of up to 18 guests across eight ensuite rooms on two floors. The lodge blends private-lodge warmth with resort amenities including a steam room, jacuzzi, drying room, laundry, and a great room with a large log fireplace. Summer activities highlighted include mountain biking, river rafting, fly-fishing, and hiking, making it a natural base for cyclists exploring the Fernie area.

address.value: 5291 Highline Drive, Fernie, British Columbia, V0B 1M6

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and corroborates OSM contact details (phone, address, email). The About page explicitly lists 'drying room' and 'laundry' as guest facilities, confirming two optional amenities. No mention of bike-specific storage, staff bike procedures, Wi-Fi, or most other amenities; the site focuses on ski/mountain experience and group accommodation rather than cycling-specific services.
concerns: OSM name is 'Alpine Lodge' but the website consistently uses 'Alpine Lodge Fernie' throughout all pages — OSM record may benefit from a name update.

Website footer shows copyright 2017, suggesting the site has not been recently updated; business appears operationally active based on booking widget and content, but some details (amenities, policies) may be outdated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, publicly bookable lodge at Fernie Alpine Resort with a functioning website, confirmed contact details, and amenities relevant to touring cyclists including laundry and a drying room.
